scope: Physical HVAC interface/manual audit; not a mounting design or complete3P

manual_dimensions_in.dimension_status: Published overall nominal dimensions; not complete solid geometry, base/gasket/pilot/fastener patterns, tolerances or unit mass. See English printed pages5–7.

manual_conflicts.locator: English printed page7 / figure6 / clearance legend
manual_conflicts.finding: FreshJet5 clearance is printed XXX; no accepted numeric replacement inferred.
